title: The complexity of bisimilarity on pointmass processes
summary: We assess the descriptive complexity of *bisimilarity* or "equality of behavior" on a family of Markov decision processes over uncountable standard Borel spaces, namely *nondeterministic labelled Markov processes* (NLMP). We show that bisimilarity is analytic for processes with a uniform assignment of finitely-supported measures to each state and label. More finely, we obtain that bisimilarity on the space of countable Kripke frames (or labelled transition systems) is classifiable by countable structures.
